description.value: Thierry is a celebrated Vancouver patisserie and chocolaterie founded by Chef Thierry Busset, a maître artisan chocolatier who trained in France and served as pastry chef at three Michelin three-star restaurants in London. The Mount Pleasant location at 10th and Main is one of three in the city, serving artisan pastries, macarons, handcrafted chocolates, fresh sandwiches, and café beverages in a neighbourhood setting with outdoor seating. Touring cyclists stopping here will find a substantial savoury menu alongside world-class sweets.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Thierry Mount Pleasant location at 265 East 10th Avenue with phone 604 336 8689, matching OSM exactly. Menu content confirms vegetarian options (Quiche Vegetarian, organic vegetable quiche, seasonal vegetarian soup) and a gluten-free cake, and the locations page confirms pick-up/online ordering for takeout. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags regarding bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging.
concerns: OSM name is 'Thierry' but the brand name across the website is 'Thierry Chocolates' and the location-specific name used internally is 'Thierry Mount Pleasant'; the short OSM name may reduce discoverability.

The website covers all three Thierry locations (Alberni, Mount Pleasant, Ambleside); amenity details specific to the Mount Pleasant branch are limited — key cyclist amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) could not be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, well-established café and patisserie on a key cycling corridor (10th Avenue) in Mount Pleasant with savoury food, outdoor seating, and takeout — a natural resupply stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The locations page notes 'designated parking located underground' for Mount Pleasant — this refers to vehicle parking, not bike parking, and was not counted as evidence for any bike-parking amenity.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists 'Quiche Vegetarian (organic vegetables)' and a seasonal vegetarian soup; cakes menu includes 'Chocolate Trio — gluten free' Black Forest cake
